items:
Discounts are automatically applied to stays, no promo codes needed. The total price already includes your savings.

Each reservation of this property includes a credit to be used towards beach gear rentals and services at La Dolce Vita! This includes bikes, beach chair and umbrella set-ups, backpack beach chairs, paddle boards, kayaks, tours/experiences and could even be used towards a beach bonfire for the entire family!



Welcome to "Magical Memories," a brand new home with a private heated pool, and only a short walk to 30A's newest beach access!



Upon entering the beautifully decorated open-concept living, kitchen, and dining area, you will notice there is more than enough seating to accommodate everyone in your group! The large family room has 2 couches and a comfy swivel chair so that everyone has a spot for movie night!! The dining area features a large gorgeous driftwood table with seating for up to 10 people and an additional 4 stools at the kitchen island! This brand-new kitchen is fully stocked with everything you will need during your stay, as well as beautifully appointed with stainless steel appliances, and gorgeous quartz countertops. On the first level of the home, you will find the first of the home's many spacious outdoor entertaining areas. The home's back patio is screened in, and furnished with a large sectional and flatscreen tv. Stepping outside onto the expansive patio you will find a dining table with seating for 6, a grill, corn hole boards, and the homes private *heated pool!! There are 4 loungers and 4 additional chairs around the pool, as well as a built in seating ledge in the pool so everyone has the perfect spot to soak up the sun!! This outdoor living space is so comfortable you may never want to go back inside!! Also on this level of the home, you will find a half bath and laundry room for your added convenience.



The second level of the home features 2 king suites and built-in twin over twin hallway bunkbeds. It is on this level that your guests can enjoy their king suite and private balcony, while you enjoy the Master suite complete with a large king-sized bed, gorgeous bathroom, and your own oversized private balcony. The Master balcony boasts a comfortable sectional with small table, as well as a flat screen tv. Moving up to the third floor of the home you will find the home's 3rd king suite, a bunk room that sleeps 6, a desk area in the hallway, and a small reading/iPad nook. The bunk room comfortable sleeps 6 with one set of twin/twin bunks and another set of queen over queen bunks. Off the bunk room there is another large balcony with seating for 4, and an outdoor pool table!!



All four of the home's bedrooms boast a private balcony, and a private full bathroom making this home the entertainer's dream! Everyone can have their own personal space, making it the ideal house for multiple families vacationing together! The backyard pool patio area is fenced, and lined with landscaping providing plenty of privacy during your stay!



Just one stay at "Magical Memories," and you will know you have found your annual family vacation spot for years to come!

-Family room

-Guest King Suite with King-sized bed and private bathroom. Access to a private balcony.



-Master Suite: King Sized Bed, large private bathroom with walk-in shower, access to an oversized private balcony with sectional, table, and tv.



3rd Floor:



-Bunk room: Twin/twin and queen over queen built-in bunks, full bathroom with walk-in shower, and access to balcony equipped with an outdoor pool table!



- 3rd King Suite with king bed, large walk-in shower. Access to a private balcony.



- Desk



-Reading/iPad nook



Amenities:



- Private *heated pool

- FREE golf cart (requires signed waiver, proof of valid drivers license and insurance prior to use.)

- Brand New Home

- Steps to Community Pool (Not heated)

- Three King Suites

- 7 outdoor spaces

- Screened-in Back Porch

- Fenced in back yard

- Outdoor Shower

- Natural Gas Grill

- Washer & Dryer

- Parking for Multiple Cars

- WiFi Internet

- Smart Flat ScreenTV in all Bedrooms and in the family room and on 2 the 1st floor and 2nd floor balconies.

- Short Walk to the Beach

- Close to Shops, Restaurants and Gulf Place



Located just one block behind the top local seafood restaurant in the area – Stinky’s Fish Camp. Ride your bike to the many quaint and eclectic shops & restaurants of Gulf Place Town Center. The Town Center is located 5 minutes from the home and is host to an amazing amount of events, live music, culture, nightlife, artists, and much more!!!



BEACH ACCESS: Dune Allen Beach/ Ft. Panic



FAQ's:



Type of coffee pot: Keurig and standard coffee pot



Parking spots: 3 vehicles + LSV in the driveway



Pet fee is non-refundable



Distance to beach: 2-3 minute walk to the beach



Bikes included: no (can use rental credit towards bikes.)



Beach Chairs & Umbrella set-up included: NO (can use rental credit toward beach chair set-up)



Private Pool heated: Yes (For an additional fee.)($25/night March-October & $35/night November-February)



Community Pool heated: no



SUGGESTED ITEMS TO BRING: Beach towels, beach chairs, sunscreen, sunglasses, bug spray, paper towels, toilet paper, trash bags, dishwasher detergent, laundry soap, bath soap, bicycles, rafts, coffee filters, antiseptic, flashlights, and beach toys.



Starter Amenity Package:



All guests are provided with an "amenity starter kit," which includes an initial supply of bath soap, shampoo, conditioner, shower gel, dishwasher pods ( x1) toilet paper, paper towels, hand soap, laundry pods (X1), and trash bags. These items are provided for your convenience, and are only intended to get you through your first 24-48 hours of your stay.



Guests are liable for golf cart damage or towing.
Our prices include all fees. No hidden fees.

description:
Dune Allen Beach, a neighborhood in Santa Rosa Beach, is home to this vacation home. While the natural beauty of Blue Mountain Beach and Miramar Beach can be enjoyed by anyone, those looking for an activity can check out Sandestin Golf Resort - Raven, Burnt Pine, Baytowne, The Links. 
Sirens at the Beach and Blast Arcade and Laser Maze are also worth visiting. Snorkeling, sailing, and surfing/body boarding offer great chances to get out on the surrounding water, or you can seek out an adventure with cycling nearby.
